ambient_events: The sagging ceiling tile releases a slow, deliberate drip.
The red emergency light buzzes, dims, and steadies again.
description: Top of the stairs, and the hotel has stopped pretending. Water stains bloom across the ceiling and the rose paper hangs in tongues. One emergency light burns red over the stairwell. Units 4A to 4D have newer locks and heavier doors. The newel post is carved with the hotel's crest and duct-taped where it broke.

flags.intro_lore: One more flight and the building gives up pretending it was ever nice. The people up here climbed past two landings to get further from the noise, the smell and each other. The one working light burns red, which some call thematic and others call the bulb they had.

name: Fourth Floor Landing
